rule: The version is the newest release below. A release email to dealers is only ever sent after the President approves that release's email in Connect 360 — a deploy never sends one.

items.text: Resources & Support now works entirely inside Dealer 360: a Document Library you can search by manufacturer, model or document type; Training & In-Service with open appointment times (Booked) or a request HCPS coordinates (Requested); manufacturer Service, Parts & Warranty cases with a case number; and My Requests & Appointments with each request's status.
Featured this month: four products HCPS features each month on Dealer Overview and the first Shop Products screen, at your own prices.

releases.title: Shipment details, emailed brochure photos, more product details

items.text: Orders & Tracking shows what each shipment contained: "Partially shipped" with the units sent so far, "Shipped in full", and any backordered items with the date HCPS recorded them.
Emailed brochures now include the product photos, the same as the printed brochure.

More manufacturer product details: feature bullets on PediFix products, Access4U ramp features and assembly instructions, Ohio Medical / GCE Zen-O Lite and M50 specifications, and Dalton's referenced HCPCS codes with a payer-coverage note.

releases.title: Golden Service & Support portal, dealer-branded brochures

items.text: Golden Service & Support now shows the full Golden Dealer Service & Support Portal inside Dealer 360 — troubleshooting guides, the training video library, parts lookup with cart, parts & service requests, service documents and labor rate claims — with your Golden account filled in.
Product brochures always show your dealership as the seller — your logo, name, address and phone (a branch uses its head office's logo, phone, email or website when it has none of its own).
HCPS Manage Dealer works in every dealer tool, including Brand & Logo Studio, favorites, reports and requests to HCPS.
Ohio Medical: photos for the Zen-O and Zen-O Lite car chargers and the external battery charger; HCPCS codes on the Zen-O Lite (E1392) and M50 (E1390). Yuwell: full product descriptions.

releases.title: Golden Service & Support, shipment details and a Help Center

items.text: Golden Service & Support: parts lookup, Golden publications, training videos and service requests in one place (where available for your account).
Orders & Tracking can list several shipments per order, with carrier tracking links and confirmed dates.
New Help & Training Center and What's New.
Account Center shows three separate facts per manufacturer: account number on file, verified by HCPS, and authorized to order — with applications and holds shown apart.
AI growth suggestions in Reports now also point to Dealer 360 tools you are not using yet — lines you can already order, your storefront, Social Ads and training.
Brochures print the manufacturer's verified MSRP for every line that publishes one, say plainly when there is none, and label the advertised price as MAP.
A line approved before your account number is on file now reads “Opening order only — held until the account is open”.
Reports keeps its tabs (Overview, Total Sales, Orders & Tracking) while you move between them.
UPS tracking numbers open the carrier's tracking page.
Quotes and brochures show the manufacturer's reference price and never allow a price below a minimum advertised price.
